# Dre Dev apps and free calculators for the trades

> Phone apps for HVAC techs, electricians, floor coating installers, roofers, concrete crews, pool techs, soft washers and makers, many with a free browser calculator that uses the same formulas. Numbers come from published tables (refrigerant PT data, NEC 310.16, IEC 60364). Every app works offline, has no account and no ads, and keeps data on the phone.

Android apps are in closed testing on Google Play and anyone can join for free: https://zhukovskyi.space/testers/ . iPhone versions are on their way to the App Store. Made by Andrii Zhukovskyi (https://zhukovskyi.space/). Support: mobile.support@zhukovskyi.space.

## Apps you can install now

### HVAC Charge: Superheat & PT

Superheat, subcooling and PT charts for R-454B, R-32, R-410A and more. Offline, no account. Android in a free closed test on Google Play ([how to join](https://zhukovskyi.space/testers/)); App Store coming. Page: https://zhukovskyi.space/apps/hvac-charge/

Built for service techs on the roof, not in the office. Enter gauge pressure and line temperature; saturation, superheat and subcooling update as you type, from published manufacturer PT charts.

Free:
- Superheat and subcooling with R-410A, R-454B, R-32 and R-22
- Pressure ↔ temperature lookup with bubble and dew points
- Works offline, no login, no ads

Pro:
- All 22 refrigerants: R-404A, R-134a, R-407C, R-448A, R-1234yf, R-290, CO2 and more
- Target superheat for fixed-orifice (piston) systems from the manufacturer charging table
- Clear add / recover call against the target
- Saved readings with notes to share with the office or customer

Free in the browser, same formulas: [Superheat & subcooling calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/superheat-subcooling-calculator.html).

### Electrician Calc: Wire & Panel

Wire size, voltage drop, panel planner and 21 electrical calculators. NEC and IEC 60364. Available on the App Store. Page: https://zhukovskyi.space/apps/electrician-calc/

Real ampacity tables, correction factors and protection checks with every step shown. NEC (AWG, feet) or IEC 60364 (mm², metres), picked from your region and switched with one tap.

Free:
- Cable size with ampacity, derating and voltage-drop check
- Voltage drop: volts, %, end voltage, minimum size
- Power and Ohm's law for DC, single and three phase

Pro:
- Panel planner: circuits to breakers, cables and RCD groups
- Motor circuits, fault level, load schedule, PF correction
- Earth fault loop, earthing conductors and electrodes
- Solar PV strings, battery and backup power sizing
- Unlimited projects with PDF reports

Free in the browser, same formulas: [Voltage drop calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/electrical/voltage-drop-calculator.html).

### CoatCalc: Epoxy Floor Coating

Epoxy and polyaspartic floor calculator: kits, flake, dew point and PDF quotes. Android in a free closed test on Google Play ([how to join](https://zhukovskyi.space/testers/)); App Store coming. Page: https://zhukovskyi.space/apps/coatcalc/

For garage-floor and concrete-coating installers. Order the right number of kits, check if you can coat today, and send a professional quote before you leave the driveway.

Free:
- Coverage: gallons and kits from area, mils, solids and waste, with a save-a-kit tip
- Flake pounds and bags
- Dew point: can I coat today?
- Job estimate with materials and cost

Pro:
- Crack and joint filler, cove and stem wall, partial-kit A:B mixer
- Pot life and recoat times adjusted for temperature
- PDF quotes, saved jobs and a supplier order list
- Client price on every estimate

Free in the browser, same formulas: [Epoxy coverage calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/coating/epoxy-coverage-calculator.html).

### PoolPro: Chemistry & Route

Pool chemical calculator: exact doses for the products you own, CSI, a test log and a service route. Android in a free closed test on Google Play ([how to join](https://zhukovskyi.space/testers/)); App Store coming. Page: https://zhukovskyi.space/apps/poolpro/

PoolPro turns a pool test into exact doses for the chemicals already on your shelf, in the order to add them. For pool owners and pool service techs. Offline, no account, no ads and no brand pushing.

Free:
- Doses for FC, pH, TA, calcium, CYA and salt
- Liquid chlorine, cal-hypo, dichlor, trichlor, acid, baking soda and more, or your own product
- TFP-style FC/CYA targets and CSI
- Gallons, ounces and pounds, or litres and grams

Pro:
- Unlimited pools, each with its own log
- Weekly service route with directions
- PDF report for every client visit
- CSV export of every test

Free in the browser, same formulas: [Pool chemical calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/pool/pool-chemical-calculator.html).

### SoftWash Pro: Mix & Quote

Soft wash calculator: SH mix ratios, downstream strength, chemical cost and PDF quotes. Android in a free closed test on Google Play ([how to join](https://zhukovskyi.space/testers/)); App Store coming. Page: https://zhukovskyi.space/apps/softwash/

For soft wash and pressure washing businesses. Mix sodium hypochlorite right, know the real strength that hits the wall, and send a clean PDF quote before you leave the driveway.

Free:
- Tank mix: SH, water and surfactant from the SH you actually have
- One-tap targets for house, roof, concrete, fence and deck
- Downstream and proportioner math: draw ratio to % at the surface
- Bucket test for your injector's real draw

Pro:
- Unlimited quotes with your price
- PDF quotes with your company name
- Job history: quoted, booked, done
- Chemical load list for the truck

### RoofCalc: Roofing Calculator

Roofing calculator: squares from the footprint and pitch, every material and PDF quotes. Android in a free closed test on Google Play ([how to join](https://zhukovskyi.space/testers/)); App Store coming. Page: https://zhukovskyi.space/apps/roofcalc/

For roofers who bid jobs every week. Measure from the ground, get the squares and every material, and send a PDF quote before you leave the driveway. No ads, works offline.

Free:
- Sloped area from length, span, overhang and pitch, gable or hip
- Eaves, rakes, ridge, hips and valleys worked out for you
- Shingle bundles with waste by roof type
- Starter, ridge cap, drip edge, underlayment, ice & water and nails

Pro:
- PDF quotes with your company name
- Saved estimates and supplier order list
- Multi-section roofs: house, garage, porch
- Tear-off tons and ice barrier by code

### SlabCalc: Concrete & Rebar

Concrete calculator: cubic yards and bags, rebar, mesh and forms on a feet-inch keypad. Pay once, no ads. Android in a free closed test on Google Play ([how to join](https://zhukovskyi.space/testers/)); App Store coming. Page: https://zhukovskyi.space/apps/slabcalc/

For contractors and serious DIYers. Type 12' 6½" in five taps and get yards, bags, rebar and forms while you type. Pro is a one-time purchase.

Free:
- Slabs, footings, pads, columns, sonotubes and post holes
- Cubic yards, cubic feet or m³ with waste
- Ready-mix rounded to the next ¼ yard
- 80, 60 and 40 lb bags, or 25 and 30 kg

Pro:
- Walls, stairs and every concrete shape
- Rebar grid: bars, sticks, laps and weight
- Wire mesh, form boards and stakes
- Ready-mix vs bags cost with your prices
- Jobs: every pour in one order

### SiteLog: Daily Report & Snags

Daily site reports and punch lists with photos. A PDF in one tap. Works offline. Android in a free closed test on Google Play ([how to join](https://zhukovskyi.space/testers/)); App Store coming. Page: https://zhukovskyi.space/apps/sitelog/

The fast, offline site diary for contractors who run their own jobs. Write the daily report in two minutes, walk the site with a punch list, and send a clean PDF before you leave.

Free:
- Weather, crew and hours with man-hours added up
- Yesterday's crew already filled in
- Work done, deliveries, delays, inspections and photos
- Punch list with photos, locations, trades and due dates

Pro:
- Unlimited projects (free: 1)
- Unlimited photos on every report and snag
- Your logo on every PDF
- Punch list PDF for one trade at a time

### Lye Calc: Soap Recipes

Lye calculator for soap making: NaOH, KOH, superfat, water, soap qualities and batch cost. Android in a free closed test on Google Play ([how to join](https://zhukovskyi.space/testers/)); App Store coming. Page: https://zhukovskyi.space/apps/lye-calc/

A soap making calculator that gets the lye right and never loses your recipes. Add oils by weight or percent, set superfat and water, and see exactly what to weigh.

Free:
- NaOH, KOH or dual lye, with lye purity
- Lye amounts from published SAP values
- Superfat, water and fragrance
- Soap qualities and fatty acid profile
- 78 oils, butters and fats; 8 starter recipes
- Save up to 5 recipes

Pro:
- Unlimited saved recipes
- Batch cost and cost per bar
- Wholesale and retail prices with your profit per bar
- Printable recipe sheet (PDF)
- Resize any recipe to a new batch size

Free in the browser, same formulas: [Lye calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/soap/lye-calculator.html).

### Focus Sprint: ADHD Timer

An ADHD-friendly focus timer: tiny sprints, a kind buddy and a soft app shield. No guilt. Available on Google Play. Page: https://zhukovskyi.space/apps/focus-sprint/

Starting is the hard part, so Focus Sprint makes it tiny: tap "Just 5 minutes" and Spark, your focus buddy, keeps you company until the timer ends. Ended early? You keep your XP. Got distracted? Spark says something kind and you try again.

Free:
- Sprints from "Just 5 minutes" to 50 minutes
- Energy check that suggests a sprint length
- Spark, a body-doubling buddy
- Soft app shield and a parking lot for stray thoughts
- Forgiving streaks, XP, badges and quests
- Home screen widget, calm noise, breathing breaks

Pro:
- Peak-hour insights: when your brain is sharpest
- Custom sprint lengths
- Unlimited apps on your shield

### Water Buddy: Drink Reminder

A cute water tracker: fill up Buddy, hit your daily goal, unlock outfits and keep your streak. Android in a free closed test on Google Play ([how to join](https://zhukovskyi.space/testers/)); App Store coming. Page: https://zhukovskyi.space/apps/water-buddy/

Drinking enough water is easier with a friend. Buddy is a little water drop who fills up every time you drink and gets happier as you go. Log a glass in one tap, hit your goal and celebrate with confetti.

Free:
- One-tap logging with a glass, a bottle or any amount
- Daily goal based on your weight and activity
- Gentle reminders, only while you are awake
- Streaks, weekly chart, light and dark themes

Pro:
- 30-day history and insights
- Your own reminder schedule
- Custom cup sizes
- Every Buddy outfit, unlocked

## Free calculators

- [Superheat & subcooling calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/superheat-subcooling-calculator.html): R-454B, R-32, R-410A, R-22 with PT lookup.
- [Refrigerant PT charts](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/): 22 refrigerants, bubble and dew columns.
- [Voltage drop calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/electrical/voltage-drop-calculator.html): AWG or mm², copper or aluminum, minimum size for 3 %.
- [Epoxy coverage calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/coating/epoxy-coverage-calculator.html): Gallons and kits from area, mils and solids.
- [Wire size calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/electrical/wire-size-calculator.html): NEC 310.16 conductor and breaker, with voltage drop.
- [AWG to mm² converter](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/electrical/awg-to-mm2.html): AWG and kcmil to mm² and back.
- [Pool chemical calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/pool/pool-chemical-calculator.html): Chlorine, baking soda, stabilizer and salt doses.
- [Baker's percentage calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/bread/bakers-percentage-calculator.html): Sourdough flour, water, starter and salt.
- [Lye calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/soap/lye-calculator.html): NaOH and water for cold process soap.
- [Days until Christmas](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/countdown/christmas-countdown.html): Live countdown to Christmas and New Year.
- [Roof pitch multiplier chart](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/roofing/roof-pitch-multiplier-chart.html): Slope factors for 1/12 to 12/12, with roof area and squares.
- [Shingle bundles calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/roofing/shingle-bundles-calculator.html): Squares and bundles from the footprint and pitch.
- [Concrete slab calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/concrete/concrete-slab-calculator.html): Yards, bags and rebar, with a table of 30 common slab sizes.
- [Garage floor epoxy calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/coating/garage-floor-epoxy-calculator.html): Gallons and kits for a 1, 2 or 3 car garage by system.
- [How much chlorine to add](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/pool/how-much-chlorine-to-add.html): Liquid chlorine, cal-hypo or trichlor for your pool's gallons.
- [Shift pattern calendars](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/shifts/): 4 on 4 off, 2-2-3, DuPont and more: calendar, hours and days off.
- [Mead ABV calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/brewing/mead-abv-calculator.html): ABV for mead, cider and wine from SG, Brix or Plato.
- [Honey per gallon calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/brewing/honey-per-gallon-calculator.html): Honey for a target gravity, or the gravity from your honey.
- [EC to ppm converter](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hydroponics/ec-to-ppm-converter.html): EC to ppm on the 500, 640 and 700 scales, and back.
- [EC and pH chart by crop](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hydroponics/ec-chart-by-crop.html): Target EC, ppm and pH for 23 vegetables, herbs and flowers.
- [Fragrance load calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/candles/fragrance-load-calculator.html): Fragrance oil for your wax weight and load percentage.
- [Candle wax calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/candles/candle-wax-calculator.html): Wax and fragrance for any jar, from the water it holds.
- [Espresso ratio calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/coffee/espresso-ratio-calculator.html): Dose, yield and brew ratio for espresso.
- [Yarn yardage calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/knitting/yarn-yardage-calculator.html): Yarn for a scarf, hat or blanket, from your own swatch.
- [Knitting gauge calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/knitting/gauge-calculator.html): Stitches to cast on and rows to work, from your gauge.
- [Embed a calculator](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/embed/): Free iframe code for your blog or shop. No sign-up.

## Refrigerant PT charts

Pressure-temperature tables with bubble and dew columns: [R-410A](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-410a.html), [R-454B](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-454b.html), [R-32](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-32.html), [R-22](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-22.html), [R-134a](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-134a.html), [R-404A](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-404a.html), [R-407C](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-407c.html), [R-407A](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-407a.html), [R-448A](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-448a.html), [R-449A](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-449a.html), [R-452A](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-452a.html), [R-513A](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-513a.html), [R-1234yf](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-1234yf.html), [R-507A](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-507a.html), [R-427A](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-427a.html), [R-408A](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-408a.html), [R-409A](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-409a.html), [R-290](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-290.html), [R-600a](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-600a.html), [R-744](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-744.html), [R-717](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-717.html), [R-12](https://zhukovskyi.space/calculators/hvac/pt-chart/r-12.html).
